notes: UMEA runs three choral All-State/Honor Choir programs: the High School All-State SATB Choir (fall), the High School Treble and TB Honors Choirs (winter), and the Junior High SATB All-State Honor Choir (winter). Registration for the HS SATB choir is done by the school director in two steps (voice-part counts, then names + payment) rather than by individual student audition on the UMEA site. The Treble/TB page still displays a stale 2025-26 performance date (January 23-24, 2026) in its News block even though its registration deadline has been updated to December 9, 2026; the 2026-27 performance date is therefore recorded as not published. Repertoire lists live in Google Docs information letters that were not retrieved.

organization.name: Utah Music Educators Association
organization.description: UMEA is Utah's state affiliate of NAfME. It administers the state's All-State and Honor Choir ensembles, state band/choir/orchestra festivals, and an annual professional conference.

programs.name: High School SATB Choir (Utah All-State Choir)
programs.description: UMEA's High School All-State SATB Choir, rehearsing and performing at the Salt Lake Tabernacle. Schools register in two steps: a May commitment of student counts by voice part, then an August submission of names with payment.

dates.title: Step 1 — submit number of participating students by voice part
dates.description: Schools commit the number of students participating, by voice part. No student names required at this step.

dates.title: Step 2 — submit payment and student names
dates.description: Students cannot participate until both registration steps are complete.

dates.title: Utah All-State Choir
dates.description: Held at the Salt Lake Tabernacle.

requirements.title: Two-step registration required
requirements.description: Registration is completed in two steps and students will not be able to participate until both steps are completed: (1) submit the number of participating students by voice part, (2) submit payment and student names.

fees.description: All-State Choir registration/participation fee, paid through the UMEA online store.

programs.name: High School Treble and TB Honors Choirs
programs.description: UMEA's high school Treble (SSAA) and TB (TTBB) Honor Choirs. Directors register their school, pay the participation fee, and submit student names.

dates.title: Treble and TB Honor Choir registration deadline

requirements.title: Three-step registration
requirements.description: To register for the Honor Choir a director must (1) register the school, (2) pay the Treble and TB Honor Choir participation fee, and (3) submit student names.

fees.description: Treble and TB Honor Choir participation fee.

programs.description: UMEA's junior high All-State Honor Choir. Students must be registered and participation fees paid in order to participate. Victor C. Johnson is announced as the 2027 guest director.
